source: user-supplied real-time macro screenshot; official BLS release not yet indexed at analysis time

interpretation.headline: In line with consensus; not an upside surprise despite a sharp acceleration versus the prior month.
interpretation.core: Monthly core CPI is hotter than expected by 0.1 percentage point, while annual core is in line and eased from 2.5% to 2.4%.
interpretation.reason: The upside surprise is concentrated in the policy-sensitive core monthly reading, which can raise the probability of a Fed hike / keep yields and the dollar firm. The in-line headline and cooling core year-over-year prevent this from being a full inflation shock.

bearish_confirmation: US 2Y/10Y yields rise after the release.
BTC loses local support with CVD down and OI flat/up, indicating fresh bearish leverage rather than only deleveraging.
bullish_absorption: BTC holds/reclaims structure despite the hotter core monthly print.
CVD stabilizes or turns up while OI does not expand bearishly on downside.
Yields/DXY fail to extend higher, suggesting the market had already priced much of the hawkish outcome.
btc_scenarios.whipsaw_risk: High in the first minutes because headline is exactly in line while core month-over-month is hotter, creating a mixed release. Do not classify direction from the first candle alone.

trader_apprentice_rule: For CPI, separate surprise from prior-month acceleration. Market direction should be conditioned on the surprise versus consensus, then confirmed by yields, DXY and BTC Price/CVD/OI. In-line headline plus hotter core MoM is mildly hawkish, not a catastrophic inflation shock.
